theOneThingToReadFirst.finding: No URL in this return was exercised from this container, and none is recorded as exercised.
theOneThingToReadFirst.why: The egress proxy answers 403 to CONNECT for every state judiciary host tried: www.courts.ri.gov, www.mdcourts.gov and www.courts.michigan.gov, through curl and through the fetch tool alike. This is not a fact about any form. It is the same class of fact as ENV-RAS01's missing Chromium, and the factory already assumes it: generate.mjs describes ACQ as a 'no-egress agent' and puts the fetch on GitHub Actions.
theOneThingToReadFirst.whatEstablishedMeansHere: A public search index returned the exact URL AND returned, from the document body at that address, the form number and revision printed on the document. That is the identity question -- is this URL that form -- which is the expensive one to get wrong, because a mis-paired entry fetches a real PDF from a real court and files a receipt binding those bytes to a form number they do not belong to. Reachability and the SHA-256 remain the runner's, and a 404 there is a cheap, loud, self-correcting failure.
theOneThingToReadFirst.whatItIsNot: It is not a substitute for exercising the URL, and no entry in the manifest claims otherwise: every one carries verification.urlExercisedByThisLane = false with this reason.

WA.question: confirm or overturn NON_PACKET_TREATMENT for census-pending-family:WA:juvenile-record-sealing-under-rcw-13-50-260, from the statute
WA.answer: CONFIRMED. The named form is a category error, not a gap.

fromTheStatute.mechanism: At the DISPOSITION hearing the court itself schedules an administrative sealing hearing, set for the first regularly scheduled sealing hearing after the latest of the respondent's 18th birthday, the anticipated end of probation, or anticipated release from JRA confinement or completion of parole. The court then holds regular sealing hearings and administratively seals the record, entering a written order on a preponderance finding that the respondent is off supervision and has paid victim restitution in full. Only if an objection is received, or the court notes a compelling reason not to seal, is a contested hearing set -- and even then the court sets it, on notice to the juvenile, the victim and counsel.

WA.verdict: NON_PACKET_TREATMENT is correct. There is no participant-filed petition under this route because the participant does not petition. The only document is JU 10.0320, Order re Sealing Records of Juvenile Offender, which is the ORDER THE COURT ENTERS, published by the Washington courts as a Word file at https://www.courts.wa.gov/FORMS/documents/JU10_0320_OR%20re%20Sealing%20Records%20of%20Juvenile%20Offender.doc.
WA.corroboratingHardEvidence: SOURCE_ACQUISITION_MANIFEST.json's own refused list already carries ju-10-0320-order-re-sealing-records-of-juvenile-offender-2022-01 twice, refused for 'no jurisdiction'. It was refused for a bookkeeping reason; it should never have been queued at all, because it is a court-entered order on a route where the participant files nothing.
WA.honestDeliverable: a guidance treatment telling the participant that sealing is automatic and court-initiated, what the three timing triggers are, that unpaid victim restitution is the one thing that stops it, and how to check whether it happened -- not a packet.

The entry bodies live here, in the lane return, and the generator reads them from here. The return is the record; the manifest is a function of it.
